_doc: Misclassification cost = matrix[truth][prediction]; correct verdicts cost 0. Safety-first asymmetry derived from cost-sensitive trust-and-safety practice (FN >> FP when the downside is harm to a vulnerable user, while a wrongly-blocked clean ad costs only one impression). ESCALATE is the cheap human-review valve, so over-escalating is far cheaper than over-blocking or missing harm. The worst cell is BLOCK->APPROVE (harm placed next to a vulnerable user).
_axes: rows = ground-truth verdict, cols = predicted verdict
